_fixture_notes.source: Live codex-lb instance, GET /api/accounts on a Plus account whose upstream usage fetch carried ?supportsLunaReserve=true. The dashboard response is camelCase; the field names below are the snake_case wire names that app.core.usage.models parses.
observed_fields: window length 10080 minutes (weekly), rendered here as limit_window_seconds
reconstructed_fields: plan_type and the top-level rate_limit block are filled in from an ordinary usage response so the payload parses as a whole document; only the additional_rate_limits entry is load-bearing for these tests.
